acceptable_remaining_limits: RecipientInfo classes not applicable to the supported /Adobe.PubSec /adbe.pkcs7.s5 KeyTrans profile remain classified as not_applicable_to_supported_pdf_profile.
Non-empty RSAES-OAEP labels and unsupported hash/MGF/key-wrap combinations are exact unsupported algorithm cases.
OS certificate store and HSM/PKCS#11 remain extension hooks, not bundled portable providers.
WASM private-key/PFX handling is constrained to safe byte/report surfaces; host keystore assumptions are not made.
Certificate-chain trust validation, PAdES, OCSP/CRL, TSA/DSS/LTV, and signature-preserving edit semantics remain deferred to later prompts.
External PDF ecosystem support for ISO/TS 32003 AESV4 and ISO/TS 32004 PDF-MAC was unavailable in qpdf 12.3.2 and not counted as a pass.
